answer: Each bonded identity escrows capital, and cryptographic evidence links coordinated equivocation across identities. For k participants, pairwise-linked penalties produce aggregate slashing of O(k²), not merely k independent fines. Upon detection, a cohort multiplier compounds with swarm size, making capital loss grow exponentially; asymmetric depreciation also raises the cost of rebuilding collateral. Thus a grove of aliases cannot dilute accountability: every voyage back to the garden of consensus risks linked losses.
